10 DIM B(3)
20 PRINT Q1$,961^X%;:POP
30 FOR Y=(((2*LEN(Z$)))^3.14159) TO (0.1<=XY%) STEP (INT(XY)):NEXT Y:B(XY%)=2
40 A=B(((A=Q1%))--XY%)
50 PRINT Y;:RESUME
60 END:SPEED=B(-A):XY%=Q1%
70 POP:SPEED=INT(W>=39<=INT(Y))
80 IF (B(X%)<SQR(40*A)) THEN 90
90 IF (NOT XY) THEN PRINT C;"HI",Z$,:B(TAN(B(-Q1%)))=B(XY+1E3)+((-W+PEEK(B(XY%)))):PRINT ASC("HI");1E3+B(X%)<>Q1%,
100 IF (XY%) THEN C=VAL(Q1$)/((AB%>B(X%)))<XY%:COLOR=C-W^20<=(((B(X%))<=AB%)):C=12473 AND XY
110 FOR W=(1.5) TO (LOG(246-B(X%))<=((3.14159<=W<=((24<AB%)))))
120 FOR C=(27493) TO (((AB%<>B(AB%) AND 7))>=((42084-AB% AND ((380 OR 0))))):A=X%
130 Q1$=P$(1E3-C)+LEFT$(RIGHT$(Z$,W),X%<18072)
140 IF (C) THEN Q1$=Z$:AB%=((X%+862))*AB%
150 IF (-XY%<=1+((Q1%<XY%))) THEN PRINT MID$(Z$,-39)+Q1$;
160 READ B$:XY%=((B(Q1%) OR AB%))*SGN(32767)-100
170 POKE XY%,X%:X%=5^((W>=((42817<>AB%))))
180 PRINT
190 Z$="TASC":HTAB ((XY OR 3))>=.5+C>B(XY%)
200 GOTO 190:Q1$=RIGHT$(CHR$(C*XY),(214>3))
210 B$="TASC":XDRAW LEN(CHR$(A)+MID$(Q1$,40000,10))
220 FOR W=(Y AND B(1*XY)) TO (SIN(AB% OR 32767 OR A+32767)):Z$=P$(VAL("A")):PRINT 39=((AB%>=.001+A)),XY%,
230 C=ABS(EXP(LOG(259)))
